exercises.instructions: Rewrite the following sentences using 'If … not' or 'Unless'. Choose the correct form.

questions.question: If the cart is not ready, we will go on foot. Rewrite using 'Unless'.
options: Unless the cart is ready, we will go on foot
Unless the cart is not ready, we will go on foot
Unless the cart is ready we will go on foot without comma
questions.answer: Unless the cart is ready, we will go on foot
questions.explanation: 'Unless' replaces 'If … not'. Remove 'not' from the verb. 'Unless' ကို 'If … not' နေရာမှာ သုံးတဲ့အခါ verb မှာ 'not' ကို ဖယ်ပါ။

questions.question: We will miss the train if we do not start now. Rewrite using 'Unless'.
options: We will miss the train unless we start now
We will miss the train unless we do not start now
Unless we will start now, we will miss the train
questions.answer: We will miss the train unless we start now
questions.explanation: 'Unless' replaces 'if … not'. Remove 'do not' and keep the positive verb. 'Unless' နောက်မှာ will မသုံးပါနဲ့။

questions.question: If marketing is not in the hands of farmers' organizations, they will not get a good realization. Rewrite using 'Unless'.
options: Unless marketing is in the hands of farmers' organizations, they will not get a good realization
Unless marketing is not in the hands of farmers' organizations, they will not get a good realization
Unless marketing is in the hands of farmers' organizations they will not get a good realization
questions.answer: Unless marketing is in the hands of farmers' organizations, they will not get a good realization
questions.explanation: 'Unless' replaces 'If … not'. Remove 'not' from the verb and keep the positive form. 'Unless' ကို 'If … not' နေရာမှာ သုံးတဲ့အခါ verb မှာ 'not' ကို ဖယ်ပါ။

questions.question: If you don't water the plants, they will not grow. Rewrite using 'Unless'.
options: Unless you water the plants, they will not grow
Unless you don't water the plants, they will not grow
Unless you water the plants they will not grow
questions.answer: Unless you water the plants, they will not grow
questions.explanation: 'Unless' replaces 'If … not'. Remove 'don't' and keep the positive verb. 'Unless' နောက်မှာ positive verb ကို သုံးပါ။

questions.question: If you study, you will pass. Rewrite using 'Unless'.
options: Unless you don't study, you will pass
Unless you study, you will not pass
Unless you don't study, you will not pass
questions.answer: Unless you don't study, you will not pass
questions.explanation: Convert 'If you study, you will pass' to 'Unless you don't study, you will not pass'. 'Unless' = 'If … not', so negate both clauses. 'Unless' က 'If … not' နဲ့ အဓိပ္ပာယ်တူတယ်။

questions.question: If you work hard, you will succeed. Rewrite using 'Unless'.
options: Unless you work hard, you will not succeed
Unless you work hard, you will succeed
Unless you don't work hard, you will succeed
questions.answer: Unless you work hard, you will not succeed
questions.explanation: 'Unless' replaces 'If … not'. 'If you work hard → you will succeed' becomes 'Unless you work hard → you will not succeed'. 'Unless' က 'If … not' နဲ့ အဓိပ္ပာယ်တူတယ်။

questions.question: I will join you unless I am working on Sunday. Rewrite using 'If … not'.
options: I will join you if I am not working on Sunday
I will join you if I am working on Sunday
I will not join you if I am working on Sunday
questions.answer: I will join you if I am not working on Sunday
questions.explanation: 'Unless' = 'If … not'. Add 'not' to the verb after 'if'. 'Unless' ကို 'If … not' ပြောင်းတဲ့အခါ verb မှာ 'not' ထပ်ထည့်ပါ။

questions.question: Rajesh normally comes on time unless his train is late. Rewrite using 'If … not'.
options: Rajesh normally comes on time if his train is not late
Rajesh normally comes on time if his train is late
Rajesh normally does not come on time if his train is late
questions.answer: Rajesh normally comes on time if his train is not late

Unless we do not curb poverty, we will be a poor nation

Unless the plants do not get sunlight, they will not grow

questions.question: If Daniel wasn't very ill, he would attend the lecture. Rewrite using 'Unless'.
options: Unless Daniel were very ill, he would attend the lecture
Unless Daniel was very ill, he would attend the lecture
Unless Daniel weren't very ill, he would attend the lecture
questions.answer: Unless Daniel were very ill, he would attend the lecture
questions.explanation: In conditional sentences with 'would', 'unless' replaces 'if … not'. Use the subjunctive 'were' for formal English. 'Unless' နောက်မှာ would မသုံးပါနဲ့။

Ronald would not be here right now unless his train was late
questions.answer: Ronald would be here right now unless his train were late

questions.question: I can't help Smith unless he tells me a problem. Rewrite using 'If … not'.

questions.question: Brain will not leave the class unless he finishes writing. Rewrite using 'If … not'.
